behavior: Carries unmodified fixed Source projector/native/pattern and pinned Ajv 8.20.0 plus regexpp 4.12.2, with dependency licenses, complete bundled-input hashes and build-tool hashes. No machine Node runtime dependency.
Private tagged graph transport preserves aliases, cycles, undefined, non-finite numbers and opaque annotation objects. No plugin validator or transform callback executes.

Default validation uses the actual upstream Ajv implementation. The private worker normalizes Object.prototype descriptor insertion order to pinned V8 so structured constant pattern text matches exactly; original descriptors and isolated application realm are preserved.
Synchronous worker call is bounded and waits for its direct process. Resource manifest and every shipped resource are hash-checked before launch.

reasons: Three structured constant cases exposed QuickJS/V8 Object.prototype enumeration order. The isolated carrier shim fixes exact emitted pattern text.
The x86 embedded Python test initially omitted its explicit repository import path; corrected fixture passed. Neither failure is acceptance evidence.

limitations: Private staged carrier only; live Python Schema encoding, trusted lazy builder callback bridge, live Config inspection provider and canonical CLI schema output remain subsequent work.
The graphs use actual Source Schemastery values, but their transport is an internal graph protocol rather than a user configuration input format.
x64 and x86 workers were executed on this Windows development host; this part does not establish new stock Windows 7 VM or full release acceptance. C1-C9 and product pin remain unpromoted.
